svg.title: OpenDART analysis · package design
svg.desc: Callers own clients, caches, and presentation: a Python application binds data access to an OpenDART SDK client and translates NoDataError to None, and the MCP server binds it to its caching gateway and maps Volatility hints to cache lifetimes; analysis never imports the SDK. Data access in opendart_analysis.upstream consists of typed callables, a FetchService keyed by SDK method name, record protocols naming only the fields a workflow reads, and Volatility hints; None means no data and errors propagate. Inside opendart-analysis, import layers run from the calendar, over the financials, events, ownership, capital, debt, dividends, profile, and governance workflows, over filings, extracts, and reports, down to the documents, directory, catalog, and internal domain foundations. The upstream and errors conventions are leaves; analysis reads no environment variables. Only DocumentStore and DirectoryLoader own tasks. Tests run offline without the SDK or MCP, and Import Linter enforces the layers.
